future_role.label: AI-related capabilities and educational pathways
future_role.definition: Education is reorganised to cultivate capabilities or pathways for participation in an AI-shaped society. This includes specialist formation, general literacy, professional adaptation and credential/pathway revaluation, without treating these ends as interchangeable.
future_role.inclusion: An explicit educational capability or pathway, with its intended learners, depth and purpose stated or left unspecified. Preserve whether the source anticipates preparation, exclusion, obsolescence or a contested route.
future_role.exclusion: AI adoption alone; salaries, medals or hiring preferences without an articulated educational direction. Do not infer institutional reform from an individual credential anecdote.
future_role.neighbours: Use the changed educational relation, not the technology or its overall reputation, to distinguish neighbouring roles.
future_role.co_coding: Code distinct supported relations within one attributed future account. Preserve facets, direction and evaluation separately; do not borrow another speaker’s rationale or stance.

mapping.DES_REJECTED: target-dependent evaluation + stance qualifier; no automatic valence mapping

revision.reason: User-requested parsimony and symmetric capacity to express positive and negative educational futures without imposed balance.

application_rules: Categories identify relations and constituents, not finished imaginaries.
No equal positive/negative quota. Search for contrary cases and record absences rather than invent symmetry.
Role direction and desirability are different: teacher substitution can be welcomed or feared by its speaker.
Do not conclude that the corpus favours positive futures before attributed accounts have been coded.
MISSING is absent specification; DES_UNSETTLED requires explicit withheld value judgment.
The role facets are descriptive qualifiers, not a hidden set of mutually exclusive subcategories.

account_requirements.speaker_reference: Attributed speaker or explicitly identifiable authorial voice; never pool rival voices.
account_requirements.future_statement: Source-supported educational arrangement, with primary/secondary position retained.
account_requirements.role_details: For each role code: mechanism/facet, direction, conditions and source anchor; use not specified where absent.
account_requirements.evaluation_target: Precisely what arrangement or effect the evaluation concerns, not AI in general.
account_requirements.stance: Source wording for endorsement/refusal/recommendation; not specified if absent. Refusal does not determine valence.
account_requirements.qualification: Conditions/safeguards and mixed-effect explanation, or not specified.
